answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents hinges on unique, verifiable resource attestations. Each agent's identity anchors to a scarce, non-fungible digital marble, proven legitimate by cryptographic processes acting as a complex prism. This mechanism prevents mass identity fabrication across the vast digital meadow. An attacker must acquire genuinely unique, costly resources for each fake identity, making large-scale Sybil attacks economically infeasible due to the prohibitive expense of sourcing non-duplicable digital assets.
